subject: Standup: leadership sync — wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks
body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Standup: leadership sync — wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Team — sending the weekly leadership snapshot early so you have time before Friday's QBR dry run. Short, actionable items below. Attachments: Q3-OKR-checks-v2.pdf (summary) and QBR-draft-notes.xlsx (slide-by-slide asks).

Wins
- Hosted API latency improvements: p50 down 12% week-over-week after kernel patch; production rollout 09/05 successful.
- Customer momentum: Acme Analytics completed POC and engineering sign-off; product integration starting this sprint.
- Cost ops: initial Optimize suggestions implemented for text-embedding workload, projected ~$18k monthly savings.

Risks / Chokepoints
- Dedicated capacity autoscaler regression: intermittent scale-down delays causing saturation at peak. Root cause: mismatch in instance drain timings (infra team investigating). Impact: potential throughput hit for two enterprise customers if not fixed by 09/14.
- QBR readiness: deck has unresolved slides on SLA exceptions and credit requests (see attached spreadsheet). Need final wording for the proposed credit ask for Acme.
- Hiring velocity: two senior SRE offers delayed by background checks — this may affect on-call capacity for next two months.

Asks (clear owners + timing)
- Marcus: please push a minimal rollback plan and an emergency autoscaler manual step-by-step (EOD Thu 09/09).
- Monica: finalize SLA exception language for slide 8 and confirm proposed credit amount; aim for Tues 09/08 12:00pm PT.
- Laura: high-level exec talking points for Friday's dry run — 3 bullets emphasizing reliability improvements, predictable economics, and support path (COB Thu 09/09).
- Vivek: coordinate with sales on the Acme negotiation cadence; confirm whether Legal wants the proposed amendment (reply by Wed 09/08).

Notes: I've highlighted the slides that still need edits in QBR-draft-notes.xlsx. If we resolve Marcus's autoscaler rollback and Monica's SLA wording by Wed EOD, we can remove the contingency slide.

Thanks — short replies are fine.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:02:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Standup: leadership sync — wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Thanks Rishi — good summary. Quick notes:
- Marcus: if autoscaler needs a manual stopgap, include expected customer impact language so I can speak to execs.
- Monica: propose two credit tiers (conservative / aggressive) so we can present options.
- Rishi: please add one-line status on hiring (who's stuck and estimated unblock).

Will prep the three talking bullets and send before COB Thu.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Standup: leadership sync — wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Rishi / Laura — reviewing credit numbers now. A couple of quick clarifications:
- Are we proposing to apply the credit to usage over the last 30 days or as an ongoing monthly concession during onboarding? My preference is a one-time onboarding credit tied to specific throughput targets.
- For the SLA wording: I can draft conservative language that preserves our SLA while offering a single short-term exception mechanism.

I'll upload edits to slide 8 and add the two credit-tier options to the spreadsheet by EOD today.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

----
From: Julie Park <julie@acme-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Standup: leadership sync — wins, chokepoints, and QBR asks

Rishi / Monica — appreciate the update and the draft slides. A couple of asks from our side before Friday:
- Can we get a one-paragraph summary of the SLA exception mechanism you propose (what triggers it, duration, rollback)? That will help our procurement team.
- On credits: we prefer the onboarding credit applied to the first 60 days of production usage — that aligns with our internal terms.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Julie Park
Head of Integrations | Acme Analytics
julie@acme-analytics.com

Attachments referenced: Q3-OKR-checks-v2.pdf (summary), QBR-draft-notes.xlsx (slide-by-slide asks)
